ios.desc:
Coverpad is a layered editor for covers, thumbnails, posts, and stories. Start from a blank canvas, or draft a layout with your own AI agent — then finish every detail yourself in Coverpad.

NO AI IN THE APP. BRING YOUR OWN.
Coverpad does not include AI, does not run models, and does not generate designs for you. Use any AI agent or assistant you already have: copy Coverpad’s layout prompt, create a draft design there, then paste the result back. It opens as an editable canvas with real text, shapes, and photo slots — ready for you to refine.

YOUR DESIGNS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE.
No account. No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No identifiers. Documents live in Files on your iPhone or iPad. Optional icon and stock photo searches send only the search words — your designs and photos never leave your device for editing.

BUY ONCE.
No subscription. No ads. Try free for 14 days, then unlock every feature forever with a one-time purchase.

ADVANCED EDITING.
• Layers with z-order, duplicate, undo and redo
• Smart snap guides; align to canvas edges, mid-edges, and center
• Rotation; linear gradients on text, shapes, and backgrounds
• Text: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, outline, shadow, rounded background chips
• Photos: shape masks, framing, filters, outline, shadow, opacity
• Shapes and icons; background photo framing
• Optional Pexels stock photos and Iconify icons

CUSTOM FONTS.
Browse a bundled library with favorites. Install fonts from Files, or send them from a computer over Wi‑Fi — no cable, no cloud.

SIZES & EXPORT.
YouTube 16:9, Instagram post, story 9:16, square, A4, Letter, and custom. Export PNG, JPEG, or HEIC at the exact pixel size. Transparent PNG when you need it. Share or Save to Photos.

Built for iPhone and iPad, with keyboard shortcuts and six languages.
